name: Tidy Assembly
eyebrow: Home cleaning, priced in the open
headline: A cleaner home, without the fuzzy quote.
intro: Set the size of your home and how often you want us. Your visit price updates instantly—no phone tag, no surprise line items.
serviceArea: Portland, Oregon · within 12 miles of the city
responseTime: We reply within one business day
included: Kitchen surfaces, sink, hob, and appliance fronts
Beds made and bins emptied with fresh liners

faqs.question: Is this the final price?
faqs.answer: It is a transparent estimate based on bedrooms, bathrooms, and frequency. Before booking, we confirm the scope, access, pets, and any unusually heavy buildup by email—then you approve the final price.

faqs.question: What is included in a standard clean?
faqs.answer: Kitchen and bathroom surfaces, exterior appliance faces, dusting, vacuuming, mopping, bed making, and bin emptying are included. Inside ovens, fridges, and cabinets are separate deep-clean requests.

faqs.question: Do I need to provide supplies?
faqs.answer: No. Our insured team brings professional products and tools. Tell us in your email if you prefer fragrance-free products or have a delicate surface.

faqs.question: Can I change or cancel a visit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Give us at least 24 hours’ notice and there is no cancellation fee. Repeat plans are flexible and never lock you into a contract.
